services.name: Pickleball Classes
services.desc: If you’re new to pickleball, the first step is understanding that success isn’t all about power-it’s about control, placement, and patience. The best beginner strategy is to keep the ball in play. Focus on consistent, controlled shots rather than trying to win every rally with speed or spin. Keep your paddle up, stay balanced, and aim for steady returns that land deep in your opponent’s court. 1️⃣ Master the Serve and Return A good serve sets the tone. Aim deep and steady rather than hard and risky. When returning, hit the ball deep as well-this gives you time to move forward toward the non-volley zone (the kitchen).
